title: US-India NSAs Discuss Security Cooperation Amid Canada Trade Negotiations
detail: US and Indian National Security Advisors held talks covering security cooperation, running in parallel to ongoing US-Canada trade negotiations as the January auto-tariff deadline approaches. The dual-track diplomacy signals Washington is managing multiple alliance relationships simultaneously while the USMCA rupture remains unresolved.

media.caption: US-India NSA security talks alongside Canada trade negotiations
